name: MailAPI
author: jmnote
description: Sends MediaWiki user email through Mail API.

MailAPIEndpoint.description: The base URL or endpoint of the Mail API service (e.g. http://localhost:8080 or http://localhost:8080/v1/messages)

MailAPIToken.description: Provider-issued bearer token for the Mail API service; keep this secret.

MailAPIWaitTimeout.description: Prefer: wait seconds (0–20). 0 hands off without waiting for provider dispatch.
